name: Double-tier Mirror
dimensions: Diameter: 7.6 cm (3 in.); Overall: 0.8 cm (5/16 in.); Rim: 0.5 cm (3/16 in.)
summary: The craft of mirror making prospered remarkably during the Warring States period, as bronzes increasingly served as luxury items for individuals.
